selection.rule: Pre-registered: the system with the highest mean validation Recall@40 over known E/S positives supplies the fixed candidate sets for reranking (ties resolved by list order). RRF k=60 is the implemented default and is not tuned.

reranking.query_sample: sha256(seed:query_id) order over all evaluated test queries; fixed before any reranking result is seen
reranking.score_formula: retrieval.rerank_with_sft: 0.8 * gain/3 + 0.2 * min-max normalized retrieval score (no session feedback)
reranking.max_queries_change: Reduced from 300 to 200 before any reranking output existed: measured local throughput was 1.94 pairs/s (below the 2 pairs/s threshold set in advance), so 300x40 pairs would take ~1.7 h.
reranking.inference_fidelity: Base weights emulate the Colab 4-bit NF4 double-quantized base with fp16 compute; on the 500 saved official-test pairs this agrees with the saved Colab adapter predictions 97.4% (macro-F1 0.2419 vs 0.2417). A bf16 full-precision base agreed only 63.4% and was rejected.
